dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains peak floor acceleration (PFA) results from linear time history analysis of multi-story buildings with moment-resisting frame (MRF) and shear wall (SW) systems.

Ground motions were scaled to match the target response spectrum for Montreal, Soil Type C, based on NBCC 2020.

The dataset includes:

acceleration time histories
processed PFA values at each floor
torsional amplification factor (TAF)

This dataset is provided to satisfy data availability requirements for a journal manuscript.
dct_title_s: Data for: Torsional Amplification of Peak Floor Accelerations in Torsionally Irregular RC Buildings
